behavior: Squash, rebase and merge landings of reviewed content are accepted; a post-review contract edit is refused
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/spec/... -run 'Stale|Squash|Rebase' -count=1 -v 2>&1); rc=$?; n=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^=== RUN'); [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$n" -ge 1 ]

behavior: Checkbox ticks, harness-owned features.json fields and CRLF do not make a review stale
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/spec/... -run 'TestContractDigest' -count=1 -v 2>&1 | grep -q '^--- PASS: TestContractDigest'

behavior: A bypass flag requires --reason and leaves a review_bypass: record in the archived proposal
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/spec/... ./internal/cmd/... -run 'TestArchiveBypassRecorded' -count=1 -v 2>&1 | grep -q '^--- PASS: TestArchiveBypassRecorded'

behavior: No archive refusal names a bypass flag
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/spec/... -run 'TestArchiveRefusalsNameNoBypassFlag' -count=1 -v 2>&1 | grep -q '^--- PASS: TestArchiveRefusalsNameNoBypassFlag'
